parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

command.description: The command to send to the container that overrides the default command from the Docker image or the task definition

cpu.description: The number of cpu units reserved for the container, instead of the default value from the task definition

environment.description: The environment variables to send to the container

memory.description: The hard limit (in MiB) of memory to present to the container, instead of the default value from the task definition

memoryReservation.description: The soft limit (in MiB) of memory to reserve for the container, instead of the default value from the task definition

name.description: The name of the container that receives the override

title: Overrides AWS ECS task docker container configurations at run time
name: AwsEcsContainerOverride
